name: Initialize project structure
acceptance_criteria: Astro frontend scaffolding exists in frontend/ with package.json; Go backend scaffolding exists in backend/ with go.mod, cmd/server/main.go, and internal/ directories for auth, transcribe, and storage packages

name: Implement whisper.cpp integration
acceptance_criteria: Go backend can call whisper.cpp to transcribe an audio file and return the transcript text; integration handles model loading (medium model) and audio format conversion

name: Basic file upload UI
acceptance_criteria: Astro frontend has a single-page upload form where users can select a video/audio file; form submits multipart data to the backend; no authentication required

name: Basic transcription endpoint
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/transcribe accepts audio file upload and returns SRT-formatted subtitles; endpoint handles common audio formats (mp3, wav, m4a)

name: Database setup
acceptance_criteria: SQLite database initialized with tables for users and jobs; file storage directory structure defined; database migrations work on fresh install

name: Email and password authentication
acceptance_criteria: User can register with email and password; user can login and receive a session token; user can logout; password is securely hashed; session persists across browser refresh

name: User dashboard
acceptance_criteria: Authenticated user sees a dashboard listing their past transcription jobs; each job shows status, filename, and creation date; user can download completed subtitle files from the dashboard

name: Background job queue
acceptance_criteria: File uploads create a job entry in the database; background worker picks up pending jobs and processes them; job results are stored and associated with the user; worker handles failures gracefully

name: Multiple output formats
acceptance_criteria: User can request subtitles in SRT or VTT format; user can request video with embedded subtitles; ffmpeg integration handles subtitle embedding into video files

name: Job status and notifications
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows real-time job progress via polling or websocket; user receives email notification when job completes; progress includes percentage or stage indicator

name: Cloudflare Tunnel setup
acceptance_criteria: Both frontend and API are accessible via Cloudflare Tunnel; tunnel configuration exists in deploy/cloudflare/; HTTPS works without additional certificate management

name: CI/CD pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Push to trunk branch triggers automatic deployment; GitHub webhook receives push events and deploys new version; deployment follows pattern from personal site infrastructure

name: Secrets management
acceptance_criteria: Sensitive configuration (API keys, DB credentials) managed with sops+age; secrets are encrypted in repository; deployment process decrypts secrets automatically

name: Create MARKETING_PLAN.md
acceptance_criteria: MARKETING_PLAN.md exists with content creator outreach strategy; includes target platforms, messaging, and initial launch plan

name: Create EXPERIMENTATION_PLAN.md
acceptance_criteria: EXPERIMENTATION_PLAN.md exists with A/B testing framework; includes audience discovery methods and metrics for success

name: Analytics integration
acceptance_criteria: Usage events are tracked (uploads, completions, downloads); analytics dashboard or export available for market validation analysis
